speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the appearance of your rash, specifically if it appears in a specific pattern like on the knuckles or between the fingers. Additionally, have you noticed any scaling or crusting on the skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda. Your symptoms of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) combined with sensory changes in the palms and your occupational exposure to artemisia (sweet wormwood) and livestock are highly suggestive of this condition. Please request a Liver Function Test and Uroporphyrin levels.
